# NRI Online

> > Comprehensive resource for Non-Resident Indians covering parenting, insurance, Indian elections, culture, and diaspora life.

NRI Online serves the Indian diaspora with practical information spanning health insurance options (ICICI Lombard, TATA AIG), Indian parenting guides, electoral data for major states (West Bengal, Haryana, Gujarat, Karnataka), and cultural content. The site bridges life abroad with connections to India through news, traditions, and community resources.

## Key Topics

- Non-Resident Indians (NRI)
- Indian diaspora
- Health insurance (family floater, mediclaim)
- Indian parenting and baby names
- Lok Sabha constituencies
- Parliamentary elections
- Indian culture and traditions
- West Bengal, Haryana, Gujarat, Karnataka
- ICICI Lombard, TATA AIG insurance
- Child development and baby care
- Indian newspapers in USA
- Electoral districts
- India elections 2019
- Cultural adjustment
- Traditional home remedies

## Parenting & Family Resources

- [Indian Parenting, Indian Baby Names, Indian Culture, Indian Traditions, Indian Languages, Facts about India](https://www.nriol.com/indianparents): NRI parenting resources: Indian baby names, culture, traditions guide
- [Indian Home Remedies](https://www.nriol.com/indianparents/indian-home-remedies.asp): Traditional Indian home remedies for common ailments and health issues

## Health Insurance

- [ICICI Lombard Health Insurance, Buy ICICI Lombard Mediclaim Insurance online](https://www.nriol.com/insurance/icici-lombard-health-insurance.asp): ICICI Lombard health insurance quotes and online mediclaim purchase
- [TATA AIG Health Insurance, TATA AIG Mediclaim Insurance, Buy TATA AIG Medical Insurance online](https://www.nriol.com/insurance/tata-aig-health-insurance.asp): TATA AIG health insurance quotes and family floater plans
